text:
**Ledgerly 5.0 (released 21 October 2026): key points**

**Action needed:** The Classic CSV export has been removed. If any team exports data to another accounting system or a spreadsheet, those imports will **break after updating**, because the new format uses different column names and puts GST in its own column. See the help article "Moving from Classic CSV" before updating.

**Also note:** Android 9 will no longer receive updates.

**New features:** Automatic recurring invoices, bulk reminders for overdue invoices, and dark mode.

**Improvements:** A faster dashboard for large accounts, better client search, ATO-aligned GST rounding, and fixes for the Western Australia due-date error, an iOS crash and duplicate notifications.

**Coming soon:** Multi-currency invoicing and credit union bank feeds.
